title: Density functional theory insights into the formation mechanisms and reaction rates of Strecker aldehydes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46959-46966
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07604H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shota Ishida, Koichi Miyagawa, Mitsuo Shoji
New reaction mechanisms of the Strecker degradation to form aldehydes are revealed using the theoretical level of density functional theory. Their activation barriers of these reactions are less than 25 kcal mol−1.
